items.title: Nvidia CEO row: Bernstein sees ‘heavy distraction’ at best, ‘ammunition’ at worst
items.summary: Investing.com -- Allegations that Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang had a relationship with a suspected Chinese intelligence source will at best be a "heavy distraction" and at worst give "significant ammunition" to lawmakers on both sides of the aisle, brokerage Bernstein said on Monday.

items.title: Nvidia (NVDA) Stock May Be A Bargain Following Data Center Regulation Fears
items.summary: NVIDIA has just come through a sharp pullback, with the stock down over the past month and year after a very large multiyear rise. This leaves a straightforward question for you as an investor: Are today’s cash flows, and the ones buyers expect over time, enough to support the current share price after this reset? items.title: Nvidia CEO’s Affair Admission Counters Past Statements on Ties
items.summary: For more than a year, Nvidia Corp. minimized the ties that Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang had with Megaspeed, the once-obscure spinoff of a Chinese gaming enterprise, and a woman named Huang Le who helped set it up.
